# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and upgrades the bundled renderer to Chrome m152. It adds asynchronous pixel reads, broadens Vulkan support, improves native lifetime safety, and updates platform packaging.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m152 and includes subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads added** — Adds backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs to SKImage and SKSurface. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Borrowed native sources remain alive** — Prevents use-after-free failures when extracting pixmap subsets or iterating region spans. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster and HarfBuzz conversion failures release memory** — Fixes native pixel-buffer and stream-asset leaks on failure paths. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Runtime effects release replaced buffers** — Disposes the previous uniform buffer when resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **Common managed operations allocate less** — Reduces avoidable allocations and lookup overhead in encoding, runtime effects, tag conversion, and HarfBuzz shaping. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET and native symbol packages expanded** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, restores its package production, and includes Apple native symbols in packs. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))
- **Nano Server gains FreeType font support** — Uses FreeType to provide bundled font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance and supporting managed helpers while aligning the bundled release with the 4.152 package line.
